name: Test Management, CI/CD Integration & Quality Governance
description: Test case management systems (TestRail, Zephyr), rich execution reporting (Allure), CI/CD pipeline test integration, flaky test governance, and quality metrics tracking.

subskills.name: Test Case Management (TestRail/Zephyr)
subskills.description: Creating test runs, mapping test cases to user stories, marking execution results, and tracking test coverage.

subskills.name: Defect Tracking & JIRA Workflow
subskills.description: Managing bug lifecycles in JIRA, linking defects to requirements, tracking bug triaging.

subskills.name: Allure & Rich Test Reporting
subskills.description: Generating Allure / JUnit test reports with embedded screenshots, trace recordings, and video attachments.

subskills.name: CI/CD Test Pipeline Integration
subskills.description: Integrating Cypress/Playwright/Postman test suites into GitHub Actions / GitLab CI with exit code gating.

subskills.name: Test Environments & Test Data Management
subskills.description: Managing test environments (Staging/QA), seeding test databases, and sanitizing test fixtures.

subskills.name: Flaky Test Quarantine & Stabilization
subskills.description: Identifying flaky tests, implementing quarantine/retrying policies, and tracking test stability metrics.

subskills.name: Quality Dashboards & KPI Telemetry
subskills.description: Building QA telemetry dashboards (pass rate, MTTR, defect escape rate, automation ROI).

subskills.name: Enterprise Test Strategy & Pyramid
subskills.description: Architecting organization-wide test strategies, test pyramid balance, and quality engineering standards.
keywords: unit vs integration vs e2e ratio

subskills.name: Production Quality Feedback Loops
subskills.description: Monitoring production error rates via Sentry/Datadog to feed back into regression test suites.

CI/CD Testing, Test Strategy, or Quality Assurance Leadership mentioned

junior.description: Manages test runs in TestRail/Zephyr, tracks defects in JIRA, and generates rich Allure test reports.

mid.description: Integrates test suites into CI/CD pipelines, provisions test data and environments, and quarantines flaky tests.

senior.description: Architects enterprise test strategies (Test Pyramid), builds QA KPI dashboards, and integrates production monitoring into test cycles.
